captions_note: the reel's captions run through the sweep; the only words of the effect are the two small tags
in_a_reel: COMMIT is the word the change lands on (a 'then' to 'now' line). Start the slot at least 0.6 s before it and leave 1 s after it
OUT = 'auto' unless the slot ends on a cut of the reel: then OUT = None and the grade holds until the cut
the two tags are the effect: set them from the reel's language, and the STYLE block from the reel's caption style
steps: edit COMMIT and LABELS in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # bakes the grade, prints the times and the handle place
run check.py      # frame count, plain first frame, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
